references.title: Netherite golem
references.description: Attack: 18 / Hp: 360 / Repaired: Netherite scraps / Drops: 1-3 netherite scraps / Info: Right click with a gold bar to apply gold trim, turning piglins neutral - Remove with shears. Right click with lava to unlock the coal golem summon ability.
references.observation: 拱状重壳围绕窄亮核心：只学主壳厚度，不学炉腹身份。

references.title: Terracotta golem
references.description: Spawns: Badlands, or by placing a clay golem statue near a heat source / Hp: 20 / Attack: Default - 2, Deadbush - 4, Cactus - 6, Repaired: Clay / Drops: 0-2 Terracotta / Info: Right click with a cactus or deadbush to toggle between melee & ranged attacks.
